messages:
Mira: Quick sync — Day0 ops checklist for Valencia private deploy. Focus: networking, IAM, KMS, audit logs. Owners? Blockers? cc @netops @sec
Devon: I'll take networking. Need customer CIDR & the internal ALB port list. Also, did they opt for egress-proxy?
Mira: CIDR they've provided: 10.40.0.0/16. No egress-proxy initially, but they want outbound via NAT + fw rules. I'll DM config.
Priya: I'll own KMS/key policies. Scheduled review tomorrow 9am PT. Reminder: require HSM-backed CMKs? @Mira
Mira: They requested HSM-backed keys for PCI. Put that in ticket.
Alex: Audit logs: forwarding to customer SIEM via S3 + push lambda. Need preferred format — they asked for JSON with timestamp in RFC3339. Also retention 90d. Any objections?
Sam: No objections. Quick note: telemetry team needs sample logs to validate parsers. Alex can you drop sample?
Alex: Yep. sample attached -> ```{ "timestamp":"2026-03-20T17:12:00Z", "event":"kms.encrypt", "principal":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:user/service-account" }```
Devon: FW rules: allow 443/80 outbound, 22 only from their jumpbox CIDR 10.40.1.0/24. Also add healthcheck IP ranges: 54.23.12.0/24
Mira: :thumbsup: On renewal risk — flagged low today but watch usage ramp. Finance asked for monthly baseline commitment by week3. I'll add to playbook.
Priya: Rotation window? They want 30-day automatic rotation. We need to confirm cross-account access for ops-runbooks.
Mira: @onboard-bot created ticket: #VAL-2345 with checklist + owners. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/VAL-2345
onboard-bot: Ticket VAL-2345 created by Mira. Due: 2026-03-25. Subscribers: Devon, Priya, Alex.
Sam: Deployment runbook dry-run scheduled Thu. Can everybody confirm availability? 11am PT?
Devon: I can make 11am PT. Will bring firewall test plan.
Priya: I'll reschedule KMS review to 10am PT so I can join runbook at 11.
Alex: 11am PT works. I'll bring sample logs and SIEM ingestor creds (sanitized).
Mira: Great. Action items: Devon=network config + healthcheck test; Priya=KMS policy + rotation docs; Alex=sample logs + SIEM hookup; Sam=runbook facilitator. I'll ping legal about data residency note. Any hidden blockers?
Sam: One small: customer wants VPC peering to another account. Need cross-account routing verified.
Devon: Peering ok but need explicit route table entries and shared security groups. I'll draft the template.
Mira: Perfect — thanks team. Posting minutes after runbook. :sparkles:
